name: fluxer-vscode
description: Update your Fluxer status with your VSCode activity
author: 3urobeat

fluxer.updateCheckInterval.description: Controls interval in ms to check for new activity and update Fluxer status. Set to 0 to disable periodic check

fluxer.statusUntil.description: Controls how long your Fluxer status will remain if not updated. Recommended to be left at default

fluxer.token.description: User Token to authenticate with Fluxer. See project README for more information: https://github.com/3urobeat/fluxer-vscode?tab=readme-ov-file

fluxer.status.format.description: Controls formatting of status text. Variables: {appName}, {activityText}

fluxer.status.activityText.description: Controls formatting of activity text to show in status text. Variable {activity} will be replaced by your active workspace or file

fluxer.status.appName.description: Application name to show in status text

fluxer.status.showIdle.description: If disabled, extension will clear {activityText} instead of showing 'Idling' when no text editor is active

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
